text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Minister of Social Affairs and Labour Kulaib says cabinet will discuss on Sunday proposed increase in charges for services it provides.
- National Bank of Kuwait launches London property purchase service.
- Head of British trade commission says foreign investors see good long-term investment prospect in Kuwait.
- Islamist grouping in Kuwait calls for replacing democratic system with Islamic Shura council.
- Britain's Prime Minister Blair reiterates support for Kuwait.
